name: motion
title: Motion
description: React wrappers for the transitions.dev snippets: Tabs, Badge, PopNumber, TextSwap, useReveal, SuccessCheck, Toggle, SearchField, Check, IconSwap, Matrix and Reel.
docs:
Motion needs these transitions.dev snippets in the app:

  npx transitions-dev add number-pop-in text-states-swap tabs-sliding notification-badge texts-reveal success-check toggle input-clear-dissolve checkbox-check icon-swap matrix-loader spinning-counter

Load obvious's primitives and a theme first, then the transitions.dev CSS, then obvious/css/transitions-bridge.css, so the colours come from the theme.
